=='''I.'''Revamped Hero==
<h3>{{HiddenSort|Kaja}}</h3>
{{Herobc/New
|hero      = Kaja
|herotitle = Nazar King
|note          = Hero Feature: A highly mobile control Support who masters Primal Lightning to soar freely across the battlefield.
|type		   = Revamp

|passivename=Wings of Lightning
|passive=Kaja's skill damage inflicts [Paralysis] on enemies, briefly slowing them and reducing their damage.

|skill1name=Ring of Order v2
|skill1=Kaja summons a ring of Primal Lightning, dealing damage to enemies while recovering HP.

|skill2name=Soaring Wings
|skill2=Kaja dashes to the target, dealing damage and knocking them back before entering the [Soaring] state, which reduces this skill's cooldown. Hitting a hero or creep extends the state's duration.

|ultimatename=Divine Binding
|ultimate=Kaja hurls a lasso at the target area, restraining enemy heroes within. Can drag to shrink its radius while the skill is active.
}}

{{Herobc/New

<h3>{{HiddenSort|Novaria}}</h3>
{{Herobc/New
|hero      = Novaria
|herotitle = 
|note          = We've noticed that Novaria's Skill 2 had too large a gap between average and high-level performance. To address this, we've made it easier to use effectively without lowering its high-end potential.
|type          = buff

|skill2name=Astral Recall
|skill2type=buff
|skill2=Movement Speed Boost: 20% initially and 60% after passing through obstacles >> 80% initially, then gradually decays to 30%

Base Damage: 230-380 (+90% Total Magic Power) (+ 4% target's Max HP) >> 260-410 (+95% Total Magic Power) (+ 5% target's Max HP)

Max Extra Damage Increase: 150% >> 120% (damage increase per buff stack remains at 15%)
}}

=='''III.'''Hero Adjustments==
<h4>Bug Fixes</h4>
Fixed an issue where using Purify would grant immunity to Clint's skill 1 damage in certain situations.

=='''IV.'''System Adjustments==
==='''A.'''Highlight Icons===
When more than 3 match result icons are obtained, they will be collapsed, and only the amount will be displayed.

==='''B.'''Season Achievements===
Added the [Claim All] feature, allowing you to claim multiple task rewards at once.
